resources.string: Tailscale receives into Download/Taildrop. Import moves completed files into the private inbox.
No send-capable devices. Check account and Taildrop sharing, then refresh.
Devices could not be loaded. Check the error above, then Refresh.
Choose up to 32 files (2 GiB each) and a device. Nothing is sent until you confirm.
Retry only unsuccessful files to %1$s? Already completed files will not be sent again.
Cancellation requested; waiting for the worker to acknowledge.
Preparation cancelled. No new transfer submitted.
A transfer is already active. Cancel or wait before sending another.
FoxyTail could not complete this operation

FoxyTail could not start su. In Magisk/KernelSU, allow superuser access for FoxyTail (dev.foxderin.tail); check this app’s root-hiding/module-unmount profile, then reopen the app. ADB root access does not authorize this app.
The root command did not receive UID 0. Allow FoxyTail superuser access in Magisk/KernelSU and check its app profile, then refresh.
su exited before starting the module command. Check FoxyTail’s superuser authorization and app profile in Magisk/KernelSU, then refresh.
The FoxyTail module command failed after root access succeeded.
Root access succeeded, but the FoxyTail module script is missing or unreadable. Check that the module is installed/enabled and visible in this app’s root profile, then restart the app.
The operation timed out. Check the root prompt and module status, then refresh History before retrying a send.
The module returned an invalid response. Update the module and companion together.
Only readable content URIs are accepted. Share the file again or use Choose files.
Choose at most 32 files, no larger than 2 GiB each.
Choose files and a device first.
Could not read/save the file. Check free space and try again.
No app can open this file. Use Share or Save a copy instead.
Android stopped foreground monitoring. The module transfer may still run; reopen History to adopt it.
Cannot read transfer status. Actual result is unknown; the module may still be sending. Reopen History to reconnect. %1$s
Previous local preparation was interrupted. Select those files again; unsubmitted private copies are cleaned up.
Some files could not be selected:\n%1$s
Local preparation failed; no send was submitted. %1$s
Send submission could not be confirmed. Check History before retrying; an accepted module job is not stopped by an app connection error. %1$s
Notifications are disabled. Transfer work still runs while active; open FoxyTail to check progress or cancel.
Only the first 1000 entries are shown. Open a subfolder to narrow the list.
No successful read yet. Refresh to load files.
Permanently delete %1$s from the private inbox? Saved and shared copies are not deleted.
Permanently delete all files from the private inbox, including files hidden by search? Saved and shared copies are not deleted.
Copy %1$s to shared Download storage? Other apps with storage access may read this copy.
A control operation is active or its result is unknown. Return to the control home to reconnect before starting another.
